services.title: Web Hosting
services.summary: Hosting provider selection, setup and ongoing website management.
services.intro: I help you choose a suitable hosting provider, set up your website and manage the agreed upkeep after launch. Hosting runs on an external provider’s infrastructure, with configuration, connections and day-to-day website care covered by your support plan.
features: Choose the right provider
Compare hosting providers and plans around your website, budget, expected traffic, required features and support needs.
Hosting setup & deployment
Set up your chosen hosting account, connect your domain and DNS, deploy the website, and check the launch or migration. Connect domain email settings where needed.
Technical performance
Configure caching, compression and delivery settings available on your chosen platform. Investigate loading issues and coordinate hosting-side problems with the provider.
SSL & HTTPS
Configure the provider’s available SSL certificates, secure connections and domain redirects, then check that visitors reach the right website.
Website care & provider support
Manage agreed updates, monitoring and troubleshooting. Coordinate with external support teams when an issue needs action from your hosting or connected service provider.
Backups & recovery
Set up supported backups, agree frequency and retention, and document restore and rollback steps. Recovery options depend on your provider and plan.
services.note: Provider accounts, subscription fees, renewals and the division of responsibilities are agreed upfront. Uptime and infrastructure support follow the provider’s terms; ongoing website management follows our agreed scope, not an implied 24/7 support promise.
prepare: Your current website, platform, domain and hosting provider, if any
Your budget, traffic needs, provider accounts and required external services
Launch or migration goals, backup needs and the support you want after launch

services.title: Website Design
services.summary: Website design, frontend development, HTML email design and external service integrations.
services.intro: Get a responsive website—from design and frontend development to the services needed for a working launch. Page structure, interactions, forms, booking tools and email come together in one connected experience, with suitable providers selected and the agreed journeys tested end to end.
features: Website & conversion review
Identify unclear messages, confusing navigation and barriers to enquiry or purchase. Use available analytics and customer feedback to prioritise improvements.
Positioning & content structure
Clarify your audience, value proposition and the questions your pages need to answer. Organise messages, page hierarchy and copy direction around those needs.
Focused landing pages
Design clear service, product or campaign pages with relevant benefits, supporting evidence and a purposeful call to action.
Responsive & accessible UX
Improve readability, navigation and form interactions across screen sizes. Consider language, accessibility and first-time digital users.
Provider selection & integrations

Help choose and connect suitable services for forms, email, bookings, analytics, payments or other agreed needs. Configure available APIs, webhooks or platform integrations and test that information reaches the right place.
Measurement & iteration
Agree useful events and consent requirements, then review available traffic and enquiry data to guide changes. Conversion results depend on the offer, audience and wider experience.
services.note: Pages, frontend development, provider connections, testing, revisions and handover are scoped upfront. Hosting setup and ongoing management sit under Web Hosting. Third-party accounts, approvals, subscriptions and usage fees are agreed separately; integrations depend on supported APIs and permissions. Conversion lifts are not guaranteed. Email work covers agreed HTML templates, client testing and platform integration; campaign sending, subscriber consent and unsubscribe handling are agreed separately.
prepare: Your website, audience, offer and main conversion goal
Priority pages, available content, known pain points and analytics
Brand assets, integrations, budget and timeline; for email: platform, template types and priority email clients
specialisms: A coherent multi-page site with brand-aligned layouts, clear benefits and a practical path to enquiry.
Positioning, case-study structure and a site that helps people understand your work and get in touch.

Brand-aligned newsletters, campaign emails and transactional templates, designed for mobile and built in HTML with email-safe layouts, inline styles and useful text fallbacks. Compatibility checks for agreed email clients and platform handover are scoped with the project.

Check metadata, links, images, forms and agreed provider connections before launch. Coordinate deployment and HTTPS with hosting setup, then hand over access, documentation and ongoing support responsibilities.

services.title: Ecommerce
services.summary: Online stores with an easy journey from product to checkout.
services.intro: Take your store from product discovery to a working checkout. Design, development and supported payment, delivery and email integrations are brought together around your customers, with provider selection, configuration and end-to-end testing included in the agreed scope.
features: Product discovery
Useful categories, product information and options that make browsing straightforward. Clarify product benefits, audience and the reasons to choose your offer.
Mobile shopping
Responsive product, navigation and cart layouts for shoppers on any screen.
Checkout & payments

Build a clear checkout flow and connect a suitable external payment gateway. Configure supported settings and test the payment journey; provider approval and account verification remain with the provider.
Orders & delivery
Configure stock, order notifications and delivery rules, and connect supported courier or fulfilment services around how you handle purchases.
Search foundations
Descriptive product and category pages with logical headings and internal links.
Connected operations
Scope courier, accounting or stock integrations around available interfaces.
services.note: Provider selection, account setup assistance, integrations, testing and ongoing support are agreed in the scope. Payment processing, courier operations and other external services are supplied by the chosen providers, with their own approvals, fees and terms. Marketplace account access, catalogue entry and listing assets are separately agreed. Sales are not guaranteed.
prepare: Your products, catalogue size and current store
Customer locations, payment and delivery needs
Existing tools, budget and launch goals
specialisms: Structure titles, benefits and product information for your store or existing Amazon listings. Plan listing imagery, simple graphics and A+ content direction within an agreed scope.
Review competing offers and customer questions to strengthen positioning and the path from browsing to purchase.
Use available sales, traffic and conversion data to prioritise catalogue, content and storefront improvements. Inventory or account work is separately agreed.

services.title: Business Systems
services.summary: Custom tools, portals and dashboards built around your operations.
services.intro: Focused tools, portals and dashboards designed and built around your operations. Existing services can be connected where they already do part of the job, bringing your interfaces, data and agreed workflows together without rebuilding everything from scratch.
features: Sales & customers
Customer records, leads, quotations and follow-ups tailored to your sales process.
Jobs & operations
Job cards, scheduling, bookings and project tracking for day-to-day coordination. Include field-team task flows and service handovers where needed.
Stock & assets
Inventory, supplier information, purchasing and equipment records.
People & admin
Internal forms, onboarding, requests and approvals with role-appropriate access. Map who owns each step so work does not get lost between teams.
Self-service portals
Customer, supplier or staff access to relevant requests, information and updates.
Reports & integrations
Useful dashboards and connections to existing tools where interfaces allow.
services.note: These are possible modules, not a fixed package. Requirements, permissions, data migration and support are scoped before development. Stakeholder access, inclusive language needs and rollout priorities are agreed with your team; this is systems design, not financial or legal consulting.
prepare: Your users, daily tasks and biggest bottlenecks
Existing tools, data and access requirements
Priorities, budget and rollout needs

services.title: Workflow Automation & AI
services.summary: Connect your tools and cut repetitive work—with AI where useful.
services.intro: Connect your existing tools and external services to automate repeated tasks and keep information moving. Workflows are configured through supported APIs, webhooks or automation platforms, with tested handovers, review points and exception handling.
features: Leads & follow-ups
Capture enquiries, update records, assign tasks and trigger reminders.
Orders & operations
Connect orders, stock changes and notifications using agreed business rules.
Approvals & admin
Route requests and documents to the right person with status tracking.
Document processing
Extract or classify information with validation before updating records.
Assisted communication
Draft replies and summarise conversations for human review.
Data & reporting
Synchronise records, build reports and flag failed tasks for attention.
services.note: Integration availability, permissions, AI review, usage costs and monitoring are agreed before rollout. Not every workflow needs AI.

Approval rules, sensitive data and exceptions

services.title: AI Assistants
services.summary: Help customers and teams find answers in your business knowledge.
services.intro: Give customers and teams an assistant connected to approved business information and suitable AI services. The interface, knowledge sources and agreed actions are configured together, with clear access limits and a route to human support.
features: Customer questions
Answer common product, service and process questions from approved sources.
Lead qualification
Collect relevant enquiry details and prepare context for your team.
Internal knowledge
Help staff find guidance they are authorised to access.
Team assistance
Summarise information, prepare drafts and guide routine tasks with review.
Connected actions
Scope bookings, status lookups or handovers through available integrations.
Testing & boundaries
Test representative questions, define limits and provide a human escalation path.
services.note: AI models and infrastructure come from the selected providers. Account access, usage fees, supported integrations, approved sources and ongoing response review are agreed before rollout. AI can make mistakes, so testing and human oversight remain important.

Colour & type basics
A small colour and typography reference for consistent everyday use.
Simple marketing layouts
Clean one-page documents, basic presentations and promotional materials.
Social graphics
Static posts, simple adverts and reusable templates in agreed sizes.
Flyers & business cards
Basic print layouts prepared to the printer’s supplied specifications.
Banners & digital assets
Simple website banners, image resizing and format adaptations.

services.title: SEO & Search
services.summary: Help relevant customers discover your business through search.
services.intro: Prioritised technical and content improvements around what your customers are searching for. Focus on useful pages, a sound website structure and meaningful measures of progress.
features: Website review
Find structural, technical and content issues that may limit discoverability.
Search intent
Research relevant terms and questions for your services and target markets. Review competing offers and customer language to focus on relevant intent, not just traffic.
On-page improvements
Refine titles, headings, internal links and page content.
Technical foundations
Review indexing, crawlability, redirects, canonicals and performance priorities.
Content planning
Plan useful service pages and supporting topics based on real customer questions. Align product information and brand messages across your website and existing marketplace listings where agreed.
Measurement & review
Review visibility, relevant traffic and tracked enquiries to guide further work.
services.note: SEO is ongoing work, not a promise of first place. Priorities, content responsibilities and reporting are agreed around your goals.
prepare: Your website, key services and target locations
Available search data and known site issues
Content resources, budget and reporting needs

services.title: Google Ads
services.summary: Focused campaigns with clear enquiry or sales goals.
services.intro: Connect your offer, audience, keywords and landing page in a focused paid campaign. Use meaningful conversion data to decide what to improve—not clicks alone.
features: Campaign planning
Define your offer, audience, target locations and goals. Clarify positioning and practical customer-acquisition priorities before spending.
Keyword targeting
Research relevant searches and exclude unsuitable terms with negative keywords.
Ads & assets
Write clear messages and prepare supporting assets around your offer.
Landing page alignment
Check the destination page matches the advert and makes the next step easy.
Conversion measurement
Plan enquiry or sales tracking with appropriate consent arrangements.
Ongoing optimisation
Review search terms, budgets and results to refine campaign priorities.
services.note: Advertising spend and management fees are separate. Results depend on your market, offer, website and budget; leads or sales are not guaranteed.
